summary: Scope expanded to add a purchasable “Streak Freeze” item (50 coins) that prevents streak reset on a missed day, plus new calendar/heatmap-style visualizations (streak calendar marking freeze-used days and a GitHub-style activity heatmap for task completion), new milestone rewards (30-day streak grants 500 coins + a “Scholar Gold” badge reflected in the Ranks section), and an 8:00 PM reminder notification if no subjects were checked off that day.
architectural_notes: Do not rename the app (explicit requirement).
Timetable completion tracking requires backend schema changes and may require a migration (main.mo/migration.mo loop risk).
Keep AI-generated background pricing unchanged (do not alter existing AI-gen background cost).
Rename request conflicts with existing requirement: do not rename the app (must be resolved before proceeding).
Level system requires persistent user progression data (current level/rank) and coin-spend transaction logic enforcing sequential unlocks.
Level progression must keep the same Level number across its 5 ranks (only increment Level after completing all 5 ranks).
Confirm/update Level upgrade pricing rule: user requests 50-coin cost to continue for subsequent upgrades (not 100).
User chose frontend-only (local state) storage for Syllabus create/edit/delete (no backend persistence for now).
Syllabus editing UI should use a popup/modal editor (not inline) and support editing both subject names and sub-topic names.
Streak Freeze feature: costs 50 coins (supersedes earlier 500-coin mention) and must record 'freeze used' per day so the streak calendar can mark those days.
known_issues: Build/editor may loop between main.mo and migration.mo when attempting schema/migration changes for timetable completion history.
App icon/logo does not match the user-provided image (reported mismatch after deployment).
Level progression currently appears incorrect: Level number may be incrementing per rank; it should stay the same for all 5 ranks within a Level.
Avatar is not being added/applied (user reports avatar not added).
Profile photo/avatar is still not working as expected after the latest deployment (user reports it still fails).
Syllabus editing is not currently available in the UI (no edit logic/buttons present), causing user inability to edit syllabus.
Pomodoro timer duration/settings cannot be changed (user reports unable to change Pomodoro timer).

existing_features.title: Add support for editing an existing timetable entry while keeping the schedule the same: the entry’s date/time (startTime/endTime) must not change, but the user must be able to update non-schedule fields (at minimum: title; optionally: activityType and colorCode).
Ensure timetable entries can be deleted from the timetable list UI and that deletion is persisted in the backend.

Add a daily completion tick box for each timetable entry. The checkbox should represent whether the entry is completed for the current day, reset automatically each new day, and allow the user to mark/unmark completion for today.
Store and display completion history for timetable-entry daily tick boxes, and allow the user to view up to the last 6 months of completion status per entry.

Charge 200 coins for each background photo upload/capture from the device (Upload Image and Take Photo in Background Settings), preventing the upload/capture from being applied if the user does not have enough coins.
Make coin-purchased (non-AI) backgrounds permanently owned: once a user buys a background, re-equipping it later must not charge coins again.
Replace the Timetable entry “history” icon button with a 🔥 emoji button that opens the same completion history dialog when tapped.
Add a daily study streak: if a user studies at least 10 minutes in a day, their streak increases by 1 day, and the streak continues day-to-day as long as the user meets the 10-minute daily threshold.

Rename all user-facing app name text to “Scholar Gold” across the UI, including: the browser tab title, the authenticated landing header/title section, the Login screen brand name, and the top navigation header brand label.

Replace the app’s brand mark (currently the GraduationCap icon in the header/login) with a static image logo derived from the user-provided “Scholar Gold” image, and ensure it renders crisply in light/dark themes.

Set the application favicon/app icon to the provided “Scholar Gold” logo image by adding the necessary icon links in the HTML entry point and placing the generated icon assets in the frontend public assets folder.

Regenerate the Scholar Gold logo/app-icon/favicons so they visually match the user-provided Scholar Gold image (referenced in project state as the uploaded “Gemini_Generated_Image_tnaecitnaecitnae.png”), producing fresh, cache-safe filenames for all required sizes.

Update all frontend references to use the regenerated, cache-safe icon filenames for: (1) the browser favicon and app icons in frontend/index.html, and (2) the brand logo image shown in the authenticated Header and the Login screen header, ensuring the displayed icon matches the provided one after a normal reload (no manual cache clearing required).

Add a Level UI in the frontend (in the authenticated experience) that displays: the current Level stage label, the next Level stage label, the coin cost to unlock the next stage, and a clear locked/unlocked state; include an "Upgrade" action that purchases the next stage using coins and refreshes the displayed coin balance and level state.

Add React Query hooks and actor calls to support Level status fetching and Level upgrade purchasing, including cache invalidation of any affected queries (at minimum: coin balance and current user profile/level status).

Fix the frontend Level Progression UI logic so it does not treat “currentStage.level === nextStage.level” as “max level reached” (since within-level rank upgrades should keep the same level number). Determine max-level state based on being at the final stage (Level 50 - Sigma Student) returned by the backend, and ensure the UI correctly shows the next stage and upgrade button for rank upgrades within the same level.

Fix the Level system end-to-end so level progression has no glitch: the current stage, next stage, max-level detection, coin costs, and upgrade flow must consistently follow the intended rules (Level number stays the same across the 5 ranks before incrementing; Level 1 - Noob is free; every paid upgrade costs 50 coins; users can only purchase the immediate next stage; max level is Level 50 - Sigma Student 🗿).
Add/fix user avatar support so uploading a profile photo from the Profile page persists to the backend and reliably renders as the user’s avatar (including after reload/log out + log in).

Add support for removing a user’s profile photo (avatar) from the Profile page by providing a clear UI action (e.g., “Remove Photo”) that, when confirmed, updates the user profile so that `profileImage` becomes `null` and the UI immediately falls back to the default avatar fallback (initial letter).

Ensure the authenticated header/avatar UI correctly reflects profile photo removal by re-rendering the fallback avatar when `profileImage` is `null` and by updating promptly after the remove-photo action completes (via existing React Query invalidation of `currentUserProfile`).

Fix the profile photo (avatar) feature end-to-end so that uploading a profile photo from the Profile page reliably persists and renders as the user’s avatar, including after reload and after logging out + logging back in.

Add a weekly study-time graph in the authenticated UI that shows minutes studied for the last 7 days, including (1) a combined total across Pomodoro + Custom timer + Stopwatch and (2) a per-mode breakdown so Pomodoro, Custom, and Stopwatch minutes are distinguishable.
Add support to edit and delete reminders from the Reminders UI, persisting changes in the backend and keeping the list of upcoming reminders in sync via existing React Query invalidation.
Ensure reminders trigger an in-app browser notification at the reminder time as accurately as possible while the app is open, and avoid duplicate notifications for the same reminder.
Add support to edit and delete tasks in the Tasks (Todo) UI, persisting changes in the backend and keeping the tasks list in sync via existing React Query invalidation.
Allow tasks to be unselected (i.e., completion can be toggled both directions) so a user can mark a task completed and later mark it as not completed again.

Add a Monthly Study Summary UI view in the authenticated experience that displays the selected month’s total minutes studied and the best week for that month, with a simple month selector (e.g., previous/next month).

Add a Study-Day Heatmap UI view (GitHub-style) that visualizes daily study minutes over the recent window (at minimum: last 90 days) using intensity levels, plus a legend that explains the intensity meaning in English.
Add a Daily Goal progress bar UI that shows today’s studied minutes versus the user’s configured daily goal, and provide a simple UI control to set/update the daily goal (in minutes).
Add Task Tags UI: allow users to add/remove tags on tasks, and provide a simple filter to view tasks by a selected tag (including an ‘All’ view).

Add ‘Notes inside each task’: allow attaching an existing note to a task (by reference) and/or creating a new note from within the task edit flow, with backend persistence of the task↔note association.

Add ‘Notes inside each reminder’: allow attaching an existing note to a reminder (by reference) and/or creating a new note from within the reminder edit flow, with backend persistence of the reminder↔note association.

Expand the coin reward shop by adding additional purchasable items beyond backgrounds, with clear item listing, coin costs, purchase confirmation, and per-user permanent ownership so previously purchased items are not charged again when re-equipped/used.
Add a new authenticated UI section for a Syllabus Tracker that displays a list of subjects, where each subject card contains exactly three sub-topic checkboxes shown under the subject.
For each subject in the Syllabus Tracker, render a progress bar above that subject that fills based on how many of the three sub-topic checkboxes are checked (0/3 to 3/3).

Add an Exam Countdown timer widget at the top of the Syllabus Tracker page/section that allows the user to choose a target date/time and displays a countdown in Days and Hours remaining until that chosen date/time.
Integrate the Syllabus Tracker + Exam Countdown into the existing authenticated navigation so users can access it from the main tab-based dashboard.
In `frontend/src/components/SyllabusTrackerSection.tsx`, add a popup (modal dialog) workflow to edit an existing Syllabus subject’s name and its three sub-topic names (frontend-only, local state).
In `frontend/src/components/SyllabusTrackerSection.tsx`, add a popup (modal dialog) workflow to create a new Syllabus subject with exactly three sub-topics (frontend-only, local state).
In `frontend/src/components/SyllabusTrackerSection.tsx`, add a delete workflow for Syllabus subjects (frontend-only, local state) with a confirmation step.
Ensure the existing Syllabus Tracker behaviors continue to work after adding popup CRUD: sub-topic checkbox toggling, per-subject progress calculation, and the existing Exam Countdown widget.

Implement a purchasable 'Streak Freeze 🧊' economy feature that costs 50 coins, deducts coins on purchase, and persists the user’s available freeze count in the backend so it is retained across reloads/logins.
Add a 'Buy Freeze' button in the authenticated UI that allows the user to purchase a Streak Freeze for 50 coins, and display the user’s current Streak Freeze count near the streak UI.

Add a GitHub-style 'Visual Heatmap 🔥' calendar to the main dashboard view directly below the Syllabus section. The heatmap should render days for a recent window (at minimum last 90 days) and mark a day as green (glowing) if at least one task was completed on that day.

Extend backend task persistence so the system can accurately compute 'tasks completed per day' historically by storing a completion timestamp for tasks. Ensure the completion timestamp is set when a task is marked completed and cleared when a task is uncompleted, and that existing tasks upgrade safely.
Reflect the 'Scholar Gold 🏅' badge in the authenticated 'Ranks' section UI by showing it as unlocked/owned once the user reaches the 30-day streak milestone, with clear English labeling.

Implement an 8:00 PM daily in-app notification check (while the app is open) that, if no Syllabus subjects have been checked off for the current day, triggers a browser notification with the exact message: "Don't break the chain! Your Sigma status is at risk! 🗿"
Persist daily Syllabus 'checked off' activity in a way that the 8:00 PM in-app notification logic can reliably determine whether any subjects were checked off today (including after a page reload).
Update the Pomodoro timer UI in `frontend/src/components/TimerSection.tsx` so the Pomodoro duration is user-configurable (not hard-coded to 25 minutes).
Persist the user-selected Pomodoro duration on the client so it is retained after page reloads and is used as the default Pomodoro duration on next visit.
Update the Focus Timer (Pomodoro) duration setting to allow values up to 600 minutes (instead of 120), including UI input constraints, local clamping, and localStorage persistence clamping.
Add a configurable Break Timer duration setting ("Break Duration (minutes)") associated with the Pomodoro workflow, and enforce a maximum of 600 minutes for the break duration as well.

Update the Level rank labels shown in the app to exactly use this 5-rank list (in this order) for every Level: "Noob", "Beginner 📈", "Advanced Student 💪🏻", "Pro Student 🔥", "Sigma Student 🗿" (i.e., remove the 🫠 emoji from the Noob rank everywhere and ensure consistent spelling/casing across UI and backend-derived display text).

Revise the Level upgrade coin-cost rules end-to-end so the required coin cost depends on the Level number: all paid upgrades within Level 1 cost 50 coins; all paid upgrades within Level 2 cost 100 coins; and for each subsequent Level up to Level 50 the paid upgrade cost increases by 50 coins per Level (i.e., paidUpgradeCost(level) = level * 50). Keep the initial stage (Level 1 - Noob) free (0 coins), keep the rule that Level number stays the same across its 5 ranks before incrementing, and keep the rule that users can only purchase the immediate next stage (no skipping).

new_feature_requests.summary: Allow editing timetable entries without changing the existing schedule (time/recurrence stays the same)
Allow deleting timetable entries
Add a tickbox per timetable entry to mark completion; tickbox resets daily at midnight
Store and display completion history for timetable tickboxes (requested up to last 6 months; previously discussed fallback to ~30 days/max safe days)
Set initial coin balance to 50 coins when a new account is created
Award 50 coins for each 60 minutes on a stopwatch (reward logic)
Charge 200 coins to upload a photo from device (existing upload feature becomes paid)
Make purchased backgrounds permanently owned so re-equipping does not require paying again
Limit stopwatch coin reward (50 coins per 60 minutes) to a maximum of 3 times per day
Change the timetable History button to a 🔥 button that opens the same history view on tap
Add a daily study streak: if user studies at least 10 minutes in a day, streak increments by 1 day
Limit the stopwatch coin reward so it can be earned at most 3 times per day (i.e., reward payout is capped to three reward events per calendar day for each user).
Rename the app to 'Scholar Gold'
Change the app photo/icon to match the user-provided image

Add a coin-gated Level system: 50 levels × 5 ranks (Noob/Beginner/Advanced/Pro/Sigma) with Level 1 Noob free, Level 1 Beginner costs 50 coins, all subsequent upgrades cost 100 coins, and only the next rank can be purchased sequentially; include backend level column and UI showing current/next level with locked/unlocked states

Extend the backend user data model to persist each user’s current Level stage as a new stored field (a "level column"), defaulting to "Level 1 - Noob 🫠" for new users and for existing users on upgrade.

Implement backend Level catalog + business rules for 250 total stages (50 × 5) with these rank names per level: Noob 🫠, Beginner 📈, Advanced Student 💪🏻, Pro Student 🔥, Sigma Student 🗿. Enforce coin-based sequential unlocking: the first stage (Level 1 - Noob 🫠) is free; the next stage (Level 1 - Beginner 📈) costs 50 coins; every subsequent upgrade costs 100 coins; users can only purchase the immediate next stage (no skipping).

Add backend public methods required by the frontend to (1) fetch the user’s current Level stage and the next purchasable stage (including its coin cost), and (2) purchase/unlock the next stage, returning the updated status after purchase.
Adjust Level system rules: Level number should remain the same across its 5 ranks (Noob→Sigma) before incrementing to the next Level number; ensure UI/backend progression reflects this
Adjust Level upgrade coin cost rules so that after the initial 50-coin upgrade, subsequent upgrades continue to cost 50 coins (instead of increasing to 100)

Update the Level system progression rules so that the Level number remains the same across the 5 ranks (Noob → Beginner → Advanced Student → Pro Student → Sigma Student) before incrementing to the next Level number, and ensure the backend’s “current stage” and “next stage” calculations reflect this (e.g., Level 1 should have 5 sequential rank upgrades before progressing to Level 2).
Change the Level upgrade coin-cost rules so that all paid upgrades cost 50 coins (including all upgrades after the first one), while keeping the initial free stage (Level 1 - Noob) at 0 coins.
Add user avatar support (avatar currently not being added/applied as expected)
Allow users to remove/delete their profile photo (avatar) from the Profile page and persist the removal

Ensure the backend persists profile photo removal: when updating the caller profile, a `null`/`none` `profileImage` value must clear the stored profile image for that user, and all profile reads (`getCallerUserProfile`/`getUserProfile`) must return `profileImage = null` afterward.
Add a weekly study-time graph showing minutes studied (Pomodoro + Custom + Stopwatch), with combined total and separate breakdown per mode
Allow users to edit and delete reminders, and ensure reminders trigger notifications at the reminder time
Allow users to edit and delete tasks
Allow tasks/reminders to be unselected (toggle off a selected state)
Add a monthly study summary view (e.g., total minutes + best week)
Add task categories/tags to group tasks
Add a daily goal progress bar showing progress toward a daily study target
Add a heatmap calendar for study days (GitHub-style)
Add a notes section inside each task or reminder
Expand the reward shop (more items to spend coins on)

Add backend support for a Monthly Study Summary that returns, at minimum, (a) total study minutes for a selected month and (b) the best week (highest 7-day total) within that month, computed from the user’s recorded study sessions (Pomodoro + Custom timer + Stopwatch) already tracked by the app.

Add backend support for a Study-Day Heatmap calendar by exposing per-day study minutes for a recent window (at minimum: last 90 days), derived from the user’s recorded study sessions (all modes combined).
Add a configurable Daily Study Goal feature: persist a per-user daily goal (in minutes) in the backend user profile, and expose methods to get/update that goal for the caller.

Add Task Categories/Tags: extend the task data model to support assigning one or more tags (text labels) to each task, and add backend methods to create/update tags on tasks and to list tasks with their tags for the caller.
Add a Syllabus Tracker: list of subjects, each with sub-topics as checkboxes and a per-subject progress bar that fills as sub-topics are checked
Add an Exam Countdown widget/timer at the top of the page that shows a countdown (Days + Hours) to a user-selected date
Add Create/Edit/Delete for Syllabus entries (subjects) in the Syllabus Tracker UI (frontend-only/local state)
Add popup-based editing UI for Syllabus subject names and sub-topic names (frontend-only/local state)
Reward rule: automatically grant 100 coins when a user reaches a 10-day study streak milestone
Add a purchasable Streak Freeze item (cost: 50 coins) that, when used, prevents the user’s streak from resetting on a missed day; include a 'Buy Freeze' UI action
Add a streak calendar view showing streak day-by-day and clearly marking days where a Streak Freeze was used
Add a GitHub-style Visual Heatmap calendar on the dashboard (below the syllabus) where each day glows green when at least one task is completed
Add a 30-day streak milestone reward: grant 500 coins and a 'Scholar Gold' badge; reflect this milestone/badge in the Ranks section
Enable notifications: at 8:00 PM daily, if no subjects have been checked off that day, send a reminder message ('Don't break the chain! ...')

Update the backend study-streak logic so that if the user misses exactly one day (i.e., the gap since last streak activity is 2 calendar days) and the user has at least 1 Streak Freeze available, the streak does not reset: consume 1 freeze and keep the streak progression continuous for that missed day.

Update streak milestone reward logic so that reaching a 10-day study streak grants 100 coins, and reaching a 30-day study streak grants 500 coins plus a 'Scholar Gold 🏅' badge. Ensure rewards are granted only once per milestone per user and are persisted in the backend.
Fix Pomodoro timer settings so the user can change/update the Pomodoro duration (currently not changeable)
Limit the maximum user-set duration to 600 minutes for both the Pomodoro timer and the break timer

Revise Level system coin-cost rules: Level 1 upgrades cost 50 coins; Level 2 upgrades cost 100 coins; for subsequent levels up to Level 50, the per-level upgrade cost increases by 50 coins each level (clarify exact formula and apply consistently across backend+UI).

Ensure existing users with previously stored Level stage data continue to work after changing the Noob label and pricing rules, without breaking Level status fetching or purchase flow; normalize/handle any legacy stored Noob rank values (e.g., "Noob 🫠") so users do not get stuck or see inconsistent labels.

projectName: Timetable entry editing and daily completion tickbox history (6 months)
